title: Channel-Dependent State Space Model for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.36453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multivariate time series forecasting (MTSF) is critical across many real-world domains. Existing deep learning approaches fall into two paradigms with distinct limitations: channel-independent (CI) methods unconditionally ignore cross-variable dependencies and model only temporal dynamics, while channel-dependent (CD) methods consider both but typically rely on architectural compromises to mitigate overfitting and computational overhead. We therefore propose Chameleon, a specialized CD state space model (SSM) that enables data-dependent, fine-grained interactions across variables while scaling linearly with their number. By connecting selective SSMs with the Kalman filter, we leverage the missing measurement update in the former for cross-variable modeling while preserving the SSM backbone for robust temporal modeling. translated_title: 面向多元时间序列预测的通道依赖状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 多元时间序列预测（MTSF）在许多现实世界领域中至关重要。现有的深度学习方法分为两种范式，各有明显的局限性：通道独立（CI）方法无条件地忽略跨变量依赖关系，仅建模时间动态；而通道依赖（CD）方法虽同时考虑两者，但通常需要在架构上做出折衷以缓解过拟合和计算开销问题。因此，我们提出了Chameleon，一种专门设计的CD状态空间模型（SSM），它能够在变量之间实现数据依赖的细粒度交互，同时计算量随变量数量线性扩展。通过将选择性SSM与卡尔曼滤波器联系起来，我们利用前者缺失的测量更新步骤进行跨变量建模，同时保留SSM主干以实现稳健的时间建模。我们进一步识别出GatedDeltaNet对时间序列任务的有利归纳偏置，将其改造作为模型主干，并加以改进（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出Chameleon，一种通道依赖的状态空间模型，通过将选择性SSM与卡尔曼滤波器结合，利用其缺失的测量更新机制实现变量间数据依赖的细粒度交互，在保持线性复杂度的同时实现稳健的多元时间序列预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes Chameleon, a channel-dependent state space model that connects selective SSMs with the Kalman filter, leveraging the missing measurement update for data-dependent, fine-grained cross-variable interactions while achieving robust multivariate time series forecasting with linear scaling.
